title: kasdan co. — Website
summary: A bright, friendly website for our donut and coffee shop, with ordering ahead and a build-your-own-donut tool.
overview: kasdan co. makes small-batch donuts and coffee on Queen St E in Sault Ste. Marie, and at the Soo Mrkt on Saturdays. We wanted the site to feel like the shop and make ordering ahead and finding us easy.

cover.alt: kasdan co. homepage: the headline Donuts worth waking up for, with Order Ahead and Build Your Own Donut buttons and floating illustrated donuts

idea.heading: The approach
body: Soft colours, a bright blue and illustrated donuts give it the shop's personality. The two main buttons are Order Ahead and Build Your Own Donut.

execution.heading: What we built
body: Design and development, online ordering, a donut builder, menu and location pages, and local SEO.
